page.layout: One column: heading "INDEX CAPITUM." at top, then the chapter list (Cap. number, question, page reference) running down the page to its foot. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. A faint digitiser watermark sits at the bottom right and is left out.

main_text.head: INDEX CAPITUM.
main_text.l: CAP. XXI. Utrùm fugere teneatur, qui fugere potuit? | p 171.
CAP. XXII. Utrùm mortem minantem liceat occidere? | p. 175.
CAP. XXIII. Utrùm ad defensionem pudicitiæ stuprare volentem liceat necare? | p. 178.
CAP. XXIV. Utrùm qui moderamine adhibito aggressorem occidit, in multam pecuniariam aut in impensas sit condemnandus? | p. 184.
CAP. XXV. Utrùm defensio cognatorum aliorumque sit permissa? | p. 187.
CAP. XXVI. Utrùm ad solam rerum defensionem furem occidere liceat? | p. 196.
CAP. XXVII. Utrùm duella licentiâ superiorum inter socios aut subbitos[?] suscepta, sint licita? | p. 212.
CAP. XXVIII. Quæ sit occasio duellorum? | p. 221.
CAP. XXIX. Utrùm duellorum ulla sit utilitas? | p. 229.
CAP. XXX. Duellantes utrùm audaces, an meticulosi[?]? | p. 233.
CAP. XXXI. Utrùm singulare certamen injuriarum illatarum, honoris defendendi gratiâ

page.notes: The page numbers are printed in blue, with some digits underlined; the figures are copied as printed. "subbitos" and "meticulosi" are doubtful readings and are marked [?]. The final entry (Cap. XXXI) runs over the page end and continues beyond the scan. The Latin is printed in a mix of roman and italic type.
